g.text: PNOZ s4 750104 is the proposed authoritative selection. Reset completes only the S12-reset-EDM-S34 start loop. It is not electrically connected to ARM or actuator commands.

g.desc: PNOZ s4 750104 is the proposed authoritative selection. Reset completes only the S12-reset-EDM-S34 start loop. It is not electrically connected to ARM or actuator commands.

g.text: NOTE 1: S12 - S1 - K1(21-22) - K2(21-22) - S34 is the proposed monitored start / EDM loop.

g.desc: NOTE 1: S12 - S1 - K1(21-22) - K2(21-22) - S34 is the proposed monitored start / EDM loop.

g.text: NOTE 2: Safety outputs 13-14 and 23-24 drive separate contactor coils; 33-34 is intentionally unused.

g.desc: NOTE 2: Safety outputs 13-14 and 23-24 drive separate contactor coils; 33-34 is intentionally unused.

g.text: 02 HR-V0 dual-channel E-stop, falling-edge monitored start, watchdog permit, EDM, and redundant contactors

g.desc: 02 HR-V0 dual-channel E-stop, falling-edge monitored start, watchdog permit, EDM, and redundant contactors

g.text: NOTE 3: The start/feedback loop has no relay diagnostic for shorts or cross-shorts; route it separately or protect it and justify fault exclusion. 41-42 and Y32 are diagnostic only.

g.desc: NOTE 3: The start/feedback loop has no relay diagnostic for shorts or cross-shorts; route it separately or protect it and justify fault exclusion. 41-42 and Y32 are diagnostic only.

g.text: NOTE 4: FSR1 and SK1/SK2 are mandatory selection gates. Verify output-contact protection, coil suppression, dropout, and stopping time before release.

g.desc: NOTE 4: FSR1 and SK1/SK2 are mandatory selection gates. Verify output-contact protection, coil suppression, dropout, and stopping time before release.
